scripts.build: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT && node --experimental-strip-types build-capability.ts prepare src "$tmp/src" "${MEDICINE_ENABLE_OCR:-enabled}" && rm -rf dist && tsc -p "$tmp/src/tsconfig.json" --outDir dist && cp -R public/. dist/ && node --experimental-strip-types build-config.ts dist "${MEDICINE_ENABLE_OCR:-enabled}"
scripts.check: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT && node --experimental-strip-types build-capability.ts prepare src "$tmp/src" enabled && tsc -p "$tmp/src/tsconfig.json" --noEmit
scripts.verify-dist: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT && node --experimental-strip-types build-capability.ts prepare src "$tmp/src" "${MEDICINE_ENABLE_OCR:-enabled}" && tsc -p "$tmp/src/tsconfig.json" --outDir "$tmp/dist" && cp -R public/. "$tmp/dist"/ && node --experimental-strip-types build-config.ts "$tmp/dist" "${MEDICINE_ENABLE_OCR:-enabled}" && diff -ru "$tmp/dist" dist
